Operations.Name: NvmetSubsysCreate
Operations.Description:
Create a NVMe target subsystem (`subsys`).

When a `subsys` contains one of more `namespaces`, and is associated with one or
more `ports` then clients may access the storage using NVMe-oF.

All clients may access the subsystem if the `allow_any_host` attribute is set.  Otherwise,
access is only permitted to `hosts` who have been associated with the subsystem.

See `nvmet.host.create` and `nvmet.host_subsys.create`.

Arguments.Name: nvmet_subsys_create
Arguments.Description: Configuration data for creating a new NVMe-oF subsystem.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the subsystem to delete.

Models.Name: NvmetSubsysCreate
Models.Description: Configuration data for creating a new NVMe-oF subsystem.

Fields.Name: AllowAnyHost
Fields.Description: Any host can access the storage associated with this subsystem (i.e. no access control).

Fields.Name: Ana
Fields.Description:
If set to either `True` or `False`, then *override* the global `ana` setting from `nvmet.global.config` for this     subsystem only.

If `null`, then the global `ana` setting will take effect.

Fields.Name: IeeeOui
Fields.Description: IEEE Organizationally Unique Identifier for the subsystem.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description:
Human readable name for the subsystem.

If `subnqn` is not provided on creation, then this name will be appended to the `basenqn` from     `nvmet.global.config` to generate a subnqn.

Fields.Name: PiEnable
Fields.Description: Enable Protection Information (PI) for data integrity checking.

Fields.Name: QidMax
Fields.Description: Maximum number of queue IDs allowed for this subsystem.

Fields.Name: Subnqn
Fields.Description:
NVMe Qualified Name (NQN) for the subsystem.

Must be a valid NQN format if provided.
